name: ecuador-alerta
description: Near-real-time monitor of fires and natural events in Ecuador using NASA FIRMS and EONET, with AI-generated summaries.
author: BerlynDev (https://github.com/BerlynDev)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
